notes: Uses wine in the evenings to switch off. Sleep is poor and stress has been high.
direction: Explore whether alcohol is being used to cope, without shaming the client, and do not normalize heavier use as a solution.

ai_kps.headline: Evening alcohol and stress
ai_kps.body: Recent sessions suggest the client uses alcohol to numb stress and loneliness, but feels conflicted about how much it is shaping sleep and mood.

latest_summary.brief_overview: The client described using a couple of glasses of wine to switch off after stressful days, then feeling low and flat the next morning.
